subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the number on the face opposite to 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/127e3996dad8e70be831af88a10d5ae1c33d5a474f09976129ad9c6db8c8301c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 and 4 are common on both the dice, it is clear that 3 will be opposite to it 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5eb7320665b83e6a62d2e48835dd3b6371eec18da99270b46dbee6ff3051afb.png] 

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
